newsitem.title: USA: RDM Sports chairman, CEO resigns.
newsitem.headline: RDM Sports chairman, CEO resigns.

text.p: RDM Sports Group Inc said on Monday that Henry Fong has resigned as a director, chairman and chief executive officer of the company.
James Rand, a director of the company, was elected as chairman and chief executive to succeed Fong, said RDM, a maker of sporting goods and recreational equipment.

RDM also said it completed a four-year, $100 million revolving credit facility with Foothill Capital Corp. It will use part of the proceeds to refinance an existing loan and the remainder as working capital.
